text: {"assertions":["On 2026-05-06, the user fixed a bug in search/query/rewriter.ts caused by an off-by-one error in a slice bound that produced empty result sets.","The bug manifested when searching for two-word phrases containing stop words, resulting in a rewritten query with no clauses left.","The bug only affected clients still pinned to the v1 SDK.","The fix corrected the slice bound and added a property test to prevent regression, submitted as PR #6522 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1.","Cold start performance improved by 3 percent after the fix, dropping to 319 ms.","The fix is covered by tests in search/query/rewriter.test.ts.","The search side query rewriter is implemented in TypeScript."]}
